Name: Shigio's Cute And Colorful Hairstyles
Author: Shigiooo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is a small mod about hairstyles, these are very colorful and their colors cannot be changed.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation details[/b][/size]
You can simply put this mod in your Mods folder. It doesn't require a lot of time.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]There are 15 cute and colorful hairstyles in this mod![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][i]You'll need both SMAPI and Fashion Sense to make this mod work.[/i][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Inspiration[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I took inspiration from multiple wigs that I saw on Pinterest.[/color][/size]
